title: Grammar Warm-Up
subtitle: Which connective fits? Choose the best word or phrase to complete each sentence.

cards.label: Sentence 1
lines: The cat keeps moving.
__________, enemies cannot
surround it.
therefore / however / suddenly

cards.label: Sentence 2
lines: __________ staying silent,
the cat travels unnoticed
through the city.
By / Although / When

cards.label: Sentence 3
lines: Danger can appear at any moment.
__________, you must pay
attention at all times.
As a result / Despite / Until

title: What is a causal connective?
lines: A causal connective shows a link between CAUSE and EFFECT.
Cause: Slow-Time calms the mind.
Effect: Everything seems to move more slowly.
We join them with a connective:
“By calming your mind, everything seems to move more slowly.”
“As a result, you will have more time to dodge attacks.”
“Therefore, a skilled hunter waits for the perfect moment.”
Find two more examples of cause and effect in the model text.

title: The same idea, three ways.
right_lines: The cat keeps moving, so enemies
As a result, it is much harder

lines: Choose one skill from the Seven Skills of the Way of Jalal.
Write the cause and the effect in your own words.
Then write the same idea THREE times,
each time using a different connective from the bank:
Version 1: use a mid-sentence connective (therefore, so, which means)
Version 2: use a fronted adverbial (As a result, / Due to this, /
Because of this, ...)
Version 3: use a By + -ing fronted adverbial
Share your three versions. Which do you think sounds the strongest?

title: Now choose another skill.
lines: Pick a different skill from the Seven Skills.
Write two or three sentences about it.
Use at least two different connectives from the bank.
Do not use the same connective twice.
Check:
•  Does your sentence explain HOW or WHY the skill works?
•  Is the present tense used throughout?
•  Is the register formal?

q1: Which connective did you find hardest to use naturally? What made it tricky?
q2: What is the difference between a causal connective and a time connective? Give an example of each.
q3: Which version of your three sentences do you think was the strongest? Why?
